narrative.details:
It is said that only one Breastplate of Bloodthirst has ever been created and that it was made for the legendary assassin, Garona. Whether this world will ever see another is doubtful.

Regardless! Our master crafters can reproduce the item given the necessary components:

*The pristine hide of the Beast.

*Frayed abomination stitchings.

*Arcanite bars.

*The skin of shadow.

BEHOLD!
narrative.objectives: In order to create the Breastplate of Bloodthirst, you will be required to bring the following items back to Malyfous Darkhammer: 1 Pristine Hide of the Beast; 10 Frayed Abomination Stitchings; 5 Arcanite Bars; 5 Skin of Shadow.
narrative.offerRewardText: I thought I would be dead and buried before I ever saw this day.An accomplishment of this magnitude can only be overshadowed by the reward.
narrative.requestItemsText: Unless you've got everything I need, you're wasting my time.
